if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("jsonlite is required to emit manuscript calculation values.")
}

find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "pyproject.toml")) || file.exists(file.path(current, ".git"))) {
      return(current)
    }
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop("Unable to locate repository root from working directory: ", start)
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

repo_root <- find_repo_root()
values_output_dir <- file.path(
  repo_root,
  "generated",
  "cache",
  "manuscript-calculation-values"
)
dir.create(values_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_values_entry <- function(file_name, entry) {
  values_output_path <- file.path(values_output_dir, file_name)
  jsonlite::write_json(entry, path = values_output_path, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
  message("Wrote manuscript calculation values: ", values_output_path)
}

X_total <- 13500000
expected_error <- 100000
performance_materiality <- 450000

att_k1 <- att_obj(alpha = 0.05, popn = X_total, popdev = performance_materiality)
att_k1 <- size(att_k1, c = 1)
n_1 <- att_k1$n

att_k0 <- att_obj(alpha = 0.05, popn = X_total, popdev = performance_materiality)
att_k0 <- size(att_k0, c = 0)
n_0 <- att_k0$n

att_k2 <- att_obj(alpha = 0.05, popn = X_total, popdev = performance_materiality)
att_k2 <- size(att_k2, c = 2)
n_2 <- att_k2$n

att_k3 <- att_obj(alpha = 0.05, popn = X_total, popdev = performance_materiality)
att_k3 <- size(att_k3, c = 3)
n_3 <- att_k3$n

sampling_interval_k1 <- X_total / n_1
sampling_interval_k2 <- X_total / n_2
expected_error_k2 <- 2 * sampling_interval_k2

sampling_interval_k0 <- X_total / n_0
sampling_interval_k3 <- X_total / n_3
expected_error_k0 <- 0
expected_error_k1 <- sampling_interval_k1
expected_error_k3 <- 3 * sampling_interval_k3

mu_0 <- upper(k = 0, popn = X_total, n = ar$n, alpha = .05)

mu_1 <- upper(k = 1, popn = X_total, n = ar$n, alpha = .05)
mu_2 <- upper(k = 2, popn = X_total, n = ar$n, alpha = .05)
mu_3 <- upper(k = 3, popn = X_total, n = ar$n, alpha = .05)

cell_t1 <- 1.00
cell_t2 <- 0.20
cell_t3 <- 0.04
cell_tbar_1 <- cell_t1
cell_tbar_2 <- (cell_t1 + cell_t2) / 2
cell_tbar_3 <- (cell_t1 + cell_t2 + cell_t3) / 3
cell_si <- X_total / ar$n

cell_simple_1 <- mu_1 * cell_tbar_1
cell_load_1 <- mu_0 + cell_t1 * cell_si
cell_stage_1 <- max(cell_simple_1, cell_load_1)

cell_simple_2 <- mu_2 * cell_tbar_2
cell_load_2 <- cell_stage_1 + cell_t2 * cell_si
cell_stage_2 <- max(cell_simple_2, cell_load_2)

cell_simple_3 <- mu_3 * cell_tbar_3
cell_load_3 <- cell_stage_2 + cell_t3 * cell_si
cell_stage_3 <- max(cell_simple_3, cell_load_3)

cell_projected_misstatement <- cell_si * (cell_t1 + cell_t2 + cell_t3)

k_value <- 1
n_star <- (k_value - n_1 / (n_2 - n_1)) / ((expected_error / X_total) - 1 / (n_2 - n_1))
n_required <- ceiling(n_star)
t_tol <- k_value + (performance_materiality - mu_1) / (mu_2 - mu_1)
partial_tainting_pct <- (t_tol - k_value) * 100

    )

)
